mod.overview: MMSFlight (MMS) leaves Base infantry combat untouched and focuses entirely on vehicle.cs, lowering Scout price (600 -> 500) while adding seven new combat aircraft at the Vehicle Station.
notes: Adds Interceptor (600), Destroyer (650), Bomber (1500), Small Fortress (2000), Large Fortress (3000), Adv. Interceptor (3000), and Kamikaze (100) alongside tweaked LAPC (675 -> 750) and HAPC (875 -> 900) pricing.

ScoutVehicle.summary: Vehicle Station price lowered from 600 to 500.
notes: All infantry weapons, armors, and packs remain stock Base.

LAPCVehicle.summary: Price raised from 675 to 750 to fit the expanded seven-aircraft roster.

HAPCVehicle.summary: Price raised from 875 to 900 alongside Heavy Fortress additions.

DestroyerVehicle.summary: Added Destroyer gunship chassis available at the Vehicle Station for 650.
notes: Part of MMSFlight's 7 new aircraft in vehicle.cs.

IcptVehicle.summary: Added fast Interceptor fighter priced at 600.
notes: Sits above Scout as an air-superiority option.

BomberVehicle.summary: Added heavy Bomber aircraft priced at 1500.

SFortressVehicle.summary: Added Small Fortress aerial gun platform priced at 2000.

LFortressVehicle.summary: Added Large Fortress flying dreadnought priced at 3000.

AIcptVehicle.summary: Added Adv. Interceptor high-performance fighter priced at 3000.
